title: Monolithically and in situ integrated PbS infrared imagers
title_zh: 单体就地集成PbS红外成像器
abstract: Image sensors are critical components in artificial intelligence1–3, yet conventional approaches bond detector arrays to readout integrated circuits (ROICs), a process that increases complexity and cost4. The ideal alternative—growing the detector directly on the ROIC from solution using raw materials—has remained elusive owing to the difficulty in achieving electronic-grade films through a ROIC-compatible process5,6. Here, inspired by biomineralization principles7, we demonstrate monolithic in situ integration (MISI) of high-performance lead sulfide (PbS) photodetectors on ROICs by means of a room-temperature aqueous process. By regulating Pb–OH complexation and suppressing environmental perturbations, we achieve quasi-single-crystalline PbS films with excellent electronic properties (carrier density approximately 2 × 1015 cm−3, mobility 124 cm2 V−1 s−1) and wafer-scale, pixel-level uniformity. Through antimony doping, the resulting photodiodes exhibit a record specific detectivity of 4.4 × 1011 Jones at 2.5 µm, surpassing commercial InGaAs detectors8. We further fabricate a 640 × 512-pixel focal-plane array that captures clear infrared images and also integrate devices directly onto flexible ROICs. This solution-based MISI approach offers a scalable and transformative route for advanced optoelectronics and sensors. A method for growing infrared image sensors directly from solution using raw materials by monolithic in situ integration of high-performance semiconductor PbS photodetectors on readout integrated circuits is described, yielding films with excellent electronic properties.
abstract_zh: 图像传感器是人工智能领域的关键组件，但传统方法将探测器阵列与读出集成电路（ROIC）结合，这一过程增加了复杂性和成本。理想的替代方案——使用原材料在ROIC上溶液生长探测器——长期以来难以实现，原因在于通过兼容ROIC的工艺实现电子级薄膜存在困难。受生物矿化原理启发，我们展示了在ROIC上将高性能硫化铅（PbS）光电探测器单体就地集成（MISI），采用室温水相工艺。通过调节Pb–OH络合并抑制环境干扰，我们获得了具有优异电子性能（载流子密度约为2 × 10¹⁵ cm⁻³，迁移率124 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹）以及晶圆级、像素级均匀性的准单晶PbS薄膜。通过锑掺杂，所得光电二极管在2.5 µm处实现了4.4 × 10¹¹ Jones的记录性能，超过了商用InGaAs探测器。我们进一步制造了一个640 × 512像素焦平面阵列，能够拍摄清晰的红外图像，并将器件直接集成到柔性ROIC上。这种基于溶液的MISI方法为先进光电器件和传感器提供了一条可扩展且具有变革性的路径。本文描述了一种通过在读出集成电路上单体就地集成高性能半导体PbS光电探测器，直接从溶液和原材料生长红外图像传感器的方法，从而获得具有优异电子性能的薄膜。
